long_biography.plain_text:
At nineteen, Craig Ross Thrupp deployed to East Timor with the Australian Army. He learned Tetum during the posting so he could communicate with local residents, support patrol work and build trust in the communities around his unit.

At Paladin Group, Thrupp held the roles of founder and director. Its regional businesses combined security and risk consulting with electrical construction, maintenance and transport support for projects operating across the Asia-Pacific. Separate units handled security services, technical work and vehicle operations, giving the group a broader project-support role than security contracting alone. His title remained founder and director as the business expanded.
